closeOut.title: B17 close-out c1: step 1 is accepted on slice/b17 (review3 of run wf_50ea9b3c-5a4, commits up to 48763c2) and its pull request 142 is red on CI's e2e job only: the sweep spec fails on every route because the Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only header carries upgrade-insecure-requests, which Chromium logs as a console error ('directive ignored in a report-only policy') and tests/e2e/sweep.spec.ts:34 expects no console errors. Fix that, re-run the sweep against the built Worker, hand in

defects.what: The report-only policy built from the directive table (line 67 lists upgrade-insecure-requests) must not carry upgrade-insecure-requests: send that directive only in the enforced Content-Security-Policy header, never in Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only. Add a unit case asserting the report-only header string has no upgrade-insecure-requests while the enforced one keeps it, watched-fail it and register it; then run the e2e sweep on the built Worker (wrangler dev on 8938) and paste the count of console errors (0) and routes passed.
defects.evidence: CI run 37278228332, job e2e (111660146303): sweep.spec.ts fails on all routes with the Chromium console error about upgrade-insecure-requests in a report-only policy; the merge agent of run wf_50ea9b3c-5a4 recorded it and fixed nothing.
